analysis.purpose: Updates orientation from two screen-derived hemisphere directions, then constructs a translated rotation matrix. Likely a virtual-trackball handler; the input records' precise roles and flag meanings remain uncertain.
analysis.observed_abi: O32: a0 is the state pointer; a1 is the output-matrix pointer. Caller gl_func_0003604C supplies *(state+0x14)+0x30 as a1. Frame is 0x108 bytes, preserving ra/s0/s1/s2. No deliberate return value is established; the C void declaration does not prove the original return type.

calls.observed_abi: a0=Vec3 output, a1=state, two Vec3 values followed by f32 scale. First vector occupies a2/a3 and stack+0x10; second occupies stack+0x14..0x1C; scale is stack+0x20. Returned v0 points to the copied Vec3.
Same output-pointer/by-value-vector/f32 ABI, using the second screen point. Returned v0 points to the copied Vec3.
a0=linked pointer at state+0x1D0 plus 0xB4; a1=stack 4x4 matrix output. Result register unused.
a0=quaternion output at state+0x68; a1=Vec3 at +0xA0; a2=Vec3 at +0xAC. Callee writes cross-product xyz and dot-product w. Result register unused.
a0=quaternion +0x68; a1=quaternion +0x58; a2=output quaternion +0x48. Hamilton product stored through a2; result register unused.
a0=quaternion output +0x78; a1=Vec3 +0xD0; a2=Vec3 +0xAC, reloaded from stack+0x50 in the jal delay slot. Result register unused.
a0=quaternion +0x78; a1=a2=quaternion +0x48, producing an in-place Hamilton product. Result register unused.
a0=quaternion +0x48; a1=stack quaternion output. Negates xyz and preserves w. Result register unused.
a0=output 4x4 matrix; a1=stack quaternion. Writes quaternion-derived rotation matrix; result register unused.
a0=output matrix; a1=Vec3 at state+0x38. Adds xyz to matrix+0x30/+0x34/+0x38. No explicit result use.
